item.title: MLB proposes 154-game regular season, playoff opponent selection
item.description: MLB's latest labor proposal would trim the regular season and let top seeded teams in the first two postseason rounds pick their opponents.
item.media:description: MLB is proposing an altered postseason format.

item.title: Mets make changes to MLB coaching staff; Jeff Albert among those who won't return
item.description: Three members of the Mets' coaching staff won't return to their roles in 2027 but the rest of the group is expected to be back next season.
item.media:description: The Mets' MLB coaching staff will not include Jeff Albert (pictured), Danny Barnes or Kevin Mahoney next season, though all three could find different roles in the organization.

item.title: The Guardians ripped up their pitching plan to win Game 4. Game 5 may be even wilder
item.description: Gavin Williams came out of the bullpen for the first time since he was in college to help his team win. More of that could be on the way.
item.media:description: Gavin Williams, the Guardians' Game 2 starter, came in to close Game 4, and he could be an option in Game 5.

item.description:
